arguments.text: Evidence shows editorial diligence, not truth of article content.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) excludes non-hearsay uses like effect on listener or conduct.

arguments.text: Proofreading conduct lacks intent to assert facts, failing hearsay definition.

arguments.text: Published article contents may be hearsay if offered to prove truth of claims.

arguments.text: Reputational harm inquiry focuses on impact, not truth of article assertions.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) only applies when evidence proves truth of matter asserted.

arguments.text: Writings require intent to assert; proofreading lacks declarative purpose.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(a)(2) writings qualify as statements only if intended as assertions.
